products.title: Sakina Embroidered Black Abaya
products.shortDescription: Timeless black luxury abaya featuring subtle hand-embroidered sleeve motifs, crafted from breathable premium Nida fabric.
products.description:
Experience Grace & Modest Luxury

The Sakina Embroidered Black Abaya is a cornerstone piece for the modern Muslim woman's wardrobe. Meticulously tailored from premium, breathable Korean Nida, it drapes gracefully with an effortless silhouette.

Key Highlights

  • Crafted from luxury soft-touch Korean Nida fabric
  • Intricate tonal Palestinian-inspired sleeve embroidery
  • Matching lightweight chiffon hijab included
  • Deep hidden side pockets for modern functionality
  • 100% ethical production directly empowering Palestinian artisan families

Care: Dry clean or delicate hand wash cold. Hang dry in shade.
